transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I just can’t shake the belief that my spouse and friends have been secretly plotting behind my back, no matter how much they deny it. It's incredibly frustrating because everyone acts like I'm making things up, but I know what's going on.
How long have you been experiencing these thoughts about your spouse and friends plotting against you, and was there a specific event that triggered these beliefs?

It’s been going on for about a year and nine months now. It all seemed to start around a major store remodel at my job when I was traveling a lot and working late nights, which led to some really tense arguments with my spouse about our time together and boundaries.

Have you experienced any other unusual beliefs or perceptions, such as hearing voices or seeing things that others cannot, in addition to the belief that your spouse and friends are plotting against you?

No, absolutely not, I don't hear any voices or see things that aren't there. My mind is completely clear, and my only concern is this very real situation where my spouse and friends are secretly communicating and testing me behind my back.
Have you ever had periods where these beliefs about your spouse and friends plotting against you were not present, or have they been consistently persistent over the past year and nine months?

No, there haven't been any breaks or periods where I didn't feel this way. It has been completely constant ever since that store remodel a year and nine months ago. It is always in my mind, and I am constantly noticing the secret ways they behave around me.
Can you describe in more detail what specific behaviors or actions from your spouse and friends have led you to believe they are plotting against you?

It started with my spouse constantly checking their phone, changing passwords, and being unusually quiet after work. Since then, I've noticed casual comments and social media posts from my friends that feel like coded messages. I'm convinced they're using group chats and code words to talk about me and test my loyalty.

Have you ever acted on these beliefs in a way that significantly impacted your daily life, relationships, or work, such as confronting your spouse or friends about the perceived plot, or have you been able to maintain your daily routines and relationships despite these thoughts?

My professional life and daily routines at the store are completely fine, and I manage my staff without any issues. However, my marriage and friendships are heavily strained because I constantly confront them, check their messages, and look for secret signs, which has led to constant arguments and emotional distance. Outside of those relationships, the rest of my life runs perfectly smoothly.
Can you tell me more about what you believe is the ultimate goal or purpose behind your spouse and friends' alleged plot against you?

I am certain they are doing this to constantly test my loyalty and watch how I react to see if I'll slip up. It feels like they have set up some secret game behind my back, and they are just waiting to see how I'll respond, but none of them will admit it.

Have you ever felt like your thoughts are being controlled or influenced by an outside force, or experienced any significant disorganized thinking or behavior that interferes with your daily functioning?

No, my thoughts are entirely my own, and I've never felt like anyone else was controlling my mind or that my thinking was disorganized. My head is completely clear, and I manage my store and daily life perfectly fine without any issues. The only thing causing problems is the constant strain and arguments in my personal relationships.

Have you ever had any periods of significant disorganization in your behavior, such as catatonia, or experienced a marked decline in your social or occupational functioning outside of the issues with your relationships?

No, I have never experienced anything like disorganized behavior or catatonia. Outside of the strain in my marriage and friendships, my life is completely normal, and I still run my retail store smoothly, manage my staff, and handle all of my daily work responsibilities without any issues.
Have you ever experienced a period where your belief in the plot was significantly less intense or where you doubted its reality, even if briefly?

No, I have never doubted it or had any periods where the feeling was less intense. For the past year and nine months, it has felt completely real to me every single day, and even when they deny it or show me their phones, I am still absolutely certain they are plotting behind my back.
